translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Yawe myatxlz-esz'ngr. X takitrde nzglqlz-krgu nide
Mz mzteadau nyzde kc tqycom Saeon, newz kxtr nyzde.
Nide king kx rngisc zmatq. X Newz Saeon myatxlz x mzte opx.
X Mzteadau nyzde rkatrpz nzabrtzkr leplz mz nrlc tqlvzo.
Gct aelwapxpe-ngrde kx trpnzngr da kx nakx mz drtqgu,
Mz nzmncpx-krmgu badr mz lrpalvc nyzdeng mz mzteadau lc.
Kzdung king nzvzmqng nztung me esz'.
Nzrpilr naotang badr lr mzteadau lc.
A' kx nzmclr nzmatq-zlwzkr mzteadau Jerusalem,
Nzkctipx-ngrdr x sc tzdwapeng mz zmwxlr,
Kc tqprtilzle nidr
Apule zvetq ngr drtq olvz kx narmika.
X nzrnrcti-lzbqng
Apule lcsu kxrtcnengr srkau ngr nounenq.
X mzli lcpwz, tqmnc-ngrgu mzteadau nyz Gct rgu,
Sc tqmcpe-kzku kx Yawe nide Gct kc tqrninr.
X atu-amqngi-zvzle mzteadau lc,
Da kc tzwai nzyapwxtipxkr melrmqgung le mzli kc.
Gct, aoti zvz drtwrgr nzaodu-krm
Mz nzvztr-krgr Mangr-nzangiongr nim.
Leplz amrlx mz nrlc tulvzo sa naglqlzlr nim mz nzxlr-krdr nzmyalz-krm.
Murde nzaclve-angidr-krm tubq.
X nigr lr Israel amrlx nzabrtz-ngrgr kz
Nztubqkr da kx pipxq.
Nigu leplz neng Gct, naolvxtiku Jerusalem,
X nabrti mzku mrkcng tztu-ngrdr kxnzaukz nedeng.
Naobqlvzti-zpwxku drkq ngrdeng x nzmqngikr lrpalvc ngrdeng,
Murde nayapwxtipx-zvzbz mz doa ne doa negung.
Nzmyalzkr Gct rgu sc tqaelwapx-lzbqngr mz mzteadau lc.
X sc tqmailzle nigu tqyc tqyc.
